candidate.name: BLOCKED_CLAUSE_ELIMINATION_FIXED_POINT
candidate.definition: Repeatedly remove blocked clauses until the unique BCE fixed point is reached.
known_properties: removal of a blocked clause preserves satisfiability
BCE is confluent, so the fixed point is canonical
blockedness checks and complete BCE reduction are polynomial-time
candidate.source: Heule/Jarvisalo/Biere and prior BCE work; Blocked Clause Elimination / Clause Elimination Procedures for CNF Formulas

sat_obstruction_family.name: EQUIVALENCE_CYCLE_E_n
sat_obstruction_family.formula: E_n = AND_i[(not x_i OR x_{i+1}) AND (x_i OR not x_{i+1})], indices modulo n
bce_fixed_point_proof: For A_i=(not x_i OR x_{i+1}), resolving on not x_i with A_{i-1} yields (not x_{i-1} OR x_{i+1}), non-tautological; resolving on x_{i+1} with A_{i+1} yields (not x_i OR x_{i+2}), non-tautological.
For B_i=(x_i OR not x_{i+1}), resolving on x_i with B_{i-1} yields (x_{i-1} OR not x_{i+1}), non-tautological; resolving on not x_{i+1} with B_{i+1} yields (x_i OR not x_{i+2}), non-tautological.
Thus no clause has a blocking literal and I_BCE(E_n)=E_n for every n>=3.

unsat_obstruction_family.name: IMPLICATION_CHAIN_U_n
unsat_obstruction_family.formula: U_n={x_1,(not x_1 OR x_2),...,(not x_{n-1} OR x_n),not x_n}
unsat_obstruction_family.unsat_proof: x_1 forces x_2,...,x_n while the last unit requires not x_n.
bce_fixed_point_proof: The first unit x_1 resolves with (not x_1 OR x_2) to unit x_2, not a tautology.
The last unit not x_n resolves with (not x_{n-1} OR x_n) to unit not x_{n-1}, not a tautology.
Every internal implication clause has a non-tautological resolvent with its predecessor on its negative literal and with its successor on its positive literal.
Hence no clause is blocked and I_BCE(U_n)=U_n for every n>=2.

composition_with_R44AI.claim: The same families can be chosen to survive both matching-lean reduction and BCE, so composing two canonical exact polynomial preprocessors still does not yield universal descent.
composition_with_R44AI.sat_family_matching_lean_argument: For E_n the full deficiency is n. For any proper subformula retaining all n variables, deficiency <= n-1. If it uses v<n variables, the induced proper subset of cycle vertices contains at most v-1 cycle edges and hence at most 2(v-1) clauses, giving deficiency <= v-2 < n. Therefore E_n is matching-lean.
composition_with_R44AI.unsat_family_matching_lean_argument: U_n is minimally unsatisfiable, hence lean and therefore matching-lean.
composition_with_R44AI.conclusion: I_BCE(I_ML(E_n))=E_n and I_BCE(I_ML(U_n))=U_n for arbitrarily large SAT and UNSAT inputs.
